summary: Frontend end-to-end verification of the 3 home cards on /home (Parking, Cartes Cadeaux, Covoiturage) for famtester@demo.sb. All 3 cards are present with the expected data-testids, are clickable, navigate to their respective pages, and the underlying APIs respond. Parking reservation succeeded end-to-end. Gift card purchase POSTs correctly but is blocked by an empty wallet (expected, not a bug). Carpool browses rides and opens the publish form.

ui_bugs.issue: At mobile viewport 430x900 the persistent 'Vérifiez votre email — Activez votre compte pour le sécuriser' banner is fixed at the bottom and visually overlaps the 'Acheter - {amount}€' button. Programmatic clicks with force=True did NOT trigger the handler at that height (no POST issued), even though the button is not disabled. Increasing the viewport height to 1200 (so the button clears the banner) lets the purchase POST go through. Likely the banner is sitting in front of (z-index/pointer-events) the button at common mobile viewports between ~800–950px tall. Same banner is visible on /parking and /carpool but doesn't sit over critical CTAs there.
ui_bugs.selector: [data-testid="purchase-btn"] vs fixed bottom banner containing 'Vérifiez votre email'

issues: Banner is positioned absolute/fixed and overlaps page content on shorter mobile viewports; impacts the giftcard purchase CTA visibility/clickability

parking.reservation_form: Opens on spot click, allows entering plate + duration
parking.api_POST_/api/parking/reservations: 200 OK - confirmation screen 'Place réservée ! Votre place au Parking Gare du Nord est confirmée pour 2h.' is shown

giftcards.api_GET_/api/giftcards/templates: 200 OK (4 templates: Classique, Anniversaire, Félicitations, Merci)
giftcards.api_POST_/api/giftcards/purchase: 400 - {"detail":"Solde insuffisant. Rechargez votre portefeuille pour acheter une carte cadeau."} -- expected per task requirements; feature is functional, needs wallet funding
giftcards.form_validates_inputs: Yes - button stays disabled until template is selected; recipient name/email/message captured

carpool.api_GET_/api/carpool/rides: 200 OK - 4 existing rides listed (Client Test FdF→StPierre, Jean Dupont FdF→Le Marin x3)
carpool.tabs_present: Rechercher / Demandes / Mes trajets / Publier un trajet
carpool.publish_ride_composer: Opens with full form: itinéraire (départ/destination), date pickers (Ce soir 18h / Demain 8h / Samedi 9h / manual datetime), places disponibles (1-7), prix par place (default 10€), 'Publier le trajet' submit button visible
carpool.reserve_buttons_present: Yes - each ride card has a 'Réserver' button (not exercised since rides come from other users)

test_results.console_errors_breakdown: Only benign 401 from /api/auth/me probe (when page is reloaded without session cookies) and 404 on an unrelated favicon-like resource. No JS exceptions.

action_items: OPTIONAL UX FIX: Adjust 'Vérifiez votre email' bottom banner so it does not overlap primary CTAs on short mobile viewports (e.g., add bottom padding to .mobile-container equal to banner height, or make the banner non-fixed/dismissable). Currently the giftcard 'Acheter' button is hidden behind the banner on a 900px-tall mobile viewport. Functionally clickable when user scrolls or dismisses the banner; functionally NOT clickable in some automation/real-mobile-device cases.
INFO ONLY (per task spec): To complete a gift-card purchase end-to-end as famtester, the wallet needs funding. Backend correctly rejects with HTTP 400 'Solde insuffisant'.
critical_code_review_comments: GiftCardsPage.handlePurchase: error path uses 'toast.error(typeof err.detail === ... )' but no other UX is provided to top up the wallet; consider linking directly to /wallet or /portefeuille when the 400 is 'Solde insuffisant' to make the next step obvious.
ParkingPage reservation flow shows the success screen but does not deduct or display the cost to the wallet. Consider linking 'Mes courses' / 'Portefeuille' to confirm payment.
UserHome.js (1074 lines) exceeds the 700-line guideline and renders inline section definitions; splitting parking/giftcards/carpool cards into their own components would improve maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% navigation, 2/3 features fully exercised end-to-end; giftcard purchase confirmed wired but blocked by empty wallet as anticipated

context_for_next_testing_agent: All three home cards (parking-section-btn, giftcards-section-btn, carpool-section-btn) are wired correctly and navigate to functional pages. Parking and Carpool require no further work. Gift card purchase backend works but famtester wallet is empty; to validate the full happy path, either credit the wallet for famtester via admin or via /api/giftcards/redeem with a seeded code. The 'Vérifier votre email' bottom banner overlaps the Acheter CTA at 430x900 mobile viewport — testers should use a taller viewport (>=1100) or dismiss the banner first when automating the giftcard flow.
